binary.primary_selection_rule: maximize pooled OOF sensitivity subject to pooled OOF specificity >= 0.90; ties higher specificity, then higher threshold
binary.note: Sp>=0.90 is an OOF selection constraint; DS2 specificity is measured, not guaranteed.
binary.accuracy_note: 阴性占约89%，准确率不适合作为本任务的主指标。
binary.prior_test_exposure: Previous binary experiments already used DS2; this is a new, prespecified revision evaluated once. It must not be described as a never-before-seen pristine test set.

oof.selected_using: pooled five-fold DS1 OOF only, record 201 excluded
oof.primary_rule: maximize pooled OOF sensitivity subject to pooled OOF specificity >= 0.90; ties higher specificity, then higher threshold
oof.secondary_rule: maximize pooled OOF Youden J = Se+Sp-1; ties higher specificity, then higher threshold

cv.purpose: DS1-only five-fold OOF operating-point selection; single final DS2 inference
cv.exclusion_reason: 201 and DS2 record 202 belong to the same subject; 201 excluded from all binary training, early stopping, OOF threshold selection and final refit
cv.fold_rule: sort DS1 eligible records by abnormal fraction, then seeded random assignment within consecutive blocks of five; each outer validation fold has 4 or 5 records
cv.primary_rule: maximize pooled OOF sensitivity subject to pooled OOF specificity >= 0.90; ties higher specificity, then higher threshold
cv.secondary_rule: maximize pooled OOF Youden J = Se+Sp-1; ties higher specificity, then higher threshold
cv.epoch_selection: within each outer-training partition, four inner validation records choose best AUC checkpoint; patience 6, min improvement 0.0001, max 24 epochs. Refit fresh on entire outer-training partition for that fixed epoch count; outer validation labels never select epochs
cv.final_refit_rule: fresh single model on all 21 eligible records for median of the five inner-selected epoch counts; fixed abnormal weight 3:1
cv.class_weight_reason: pre-specified retention of the original 3:1 training setting; no class-weight reselection in this revision

training.scheduler: cosine T_max=24 for both inner training and fixed-epoch refits

cv.primary_metric: AUC; accuracy is subordinate to the selected operating point
cv.test_policy: freeze OOF thresholds and final model hash before DS2. Infer one clean probability vector once; derive all predeclared workpoints, all-normal baseline, and complete exploratory threshold curves from that cached vector. No DS2-based changes.
cv.test_exploration_label: 探索性分析，仅展示冻结后模型的阈值敏感性，不参与选择工作点
cv.prior_test_exposure: Previous binary experiments already used DS2; this is a new, prespecified revision evaluated once. It must not be described as a never-before-seen pristine test set.
cv.existing_experiments_preserved: Prior four-class, DnCNN and noise results are unchanged and remain attributed to their own model/threshold; do not transfer their noise metrics to this refitted binary model.

aux_split.rule: one validation record per DS1 eligible abnormal-fraction quartile; minimize per-class validation fraction discrepancy from 4/21; every class present on both sides; seeded ties

training.noise_split: per channel chronological first 65% training/validation; last 35% testing; split before concatenating channels

metadata.noise_source_split: per channel chronological first 65% training/validation; last 35% testing; split before concatenating channels
metadata.classification_preprocessing: shared per-beat z-score for all three methods; previous noise evaluation already standardized beats

demo.interpretation: record 208 is DS1 training/validation material; this is a functional demonstration, not independent classification validation

cost.scope: network forward only; excludes filtering/R-peak detection/normalization/I-O
cost.int8_note: weight byte-count estimate only; no INT8 execution or MCU measurement
